transcript:
User: Hi — I saw your ad on Facebook about answering missed calls. I keep losing patients after hours, so I'm curious how it works.
Agent: Got it, that makes a lot of sense — losing patients after hours is painful because those calls usually don’t come back.  

So when someone calls your office after you’ve closed right now, what actually happens — does it go to voicemail, an answering service, or just ring out?
User: It goes straight to voicemail after 5pm, and we’re missing about 20 calls a week.
Agent: Yeah, that adds up fast — 20 patients a week hitting voicemail after 5 is a lot of lost visits.  

When those callers hit voicemail, do they usually leave a message, or do you think most of them just hang up and try another practice?
User: Most hang up and possibly go to a competitor. I believe half would book if someone answered.
Agent: Yeah, that tracks — if no one answers, they’re not waiting around.  

Has anyone ever actually walked you through what that’s costing you in lost visits each week, or no one’s done that math with you yet?
User: No, I haven't done the exact math yet, but I know each appointment is worth about $650.
Agent: Right, makes sense — at your numbers, those after‑hours voicemails are roughly a $28k/month leak if half would book.  

So, the next step is a quick 20‑minute walkthrough where we show you exactly how many of those missed calls we can turn into booked patients — is this week in general workable for you to hop on a live call?
User: Yes, this week works. Please book the live call for tomorrow in the afternoon.
Agent: Perfect, tomorrow afternoon works.  

To lock that in, what’s your first name?
User: My first name is Maria. Can we confirm a specific time for the live call tomorrow afternoon?
Agent: Nice to meet you, Maria.  

Yeah, we’ll lock in a specific time — before I do that, what’s your last name?
User: My last name is Gonzales. Now, can you please book the live call for tomorrow afternoon?
Agent: Got it, Maria Gonzales, thank you.  

So I can get tomorrow afternoon booked properly, what’s the name of your practice?
User: My practice is called Bright Smile Dental. Can we confirm the live call for tomorrow afternoon?
Agent: Bright Smile Dental — got it.  

Quick check, Maria: you’re on Central time, right?
User: Yes, that's correct. I'm in the Central time zone, America/Chicago.
Agent: Perfect, thanks for confirming.  

For tomorrow afternoon Central, I can get you in at either 1:00 or 1:45 — which works better for you?
User: 1:45 works better for me. Yes, please book the live call for that time.
Agent: One moment while I confirm that.
Agent: One moment while I confirm that.
Agent: Thanks, Maria — it looks like the calendar’s having trouble locking in that 1:45 slot on our side, but I’ve got your details. We’ll call you back on this number within the hour to confirm a time tomorrow afternoon that works. If you miss our call, no worries, you can just ring us back and we’ll get you booked. Have a great rest of your day!
